title: Rauvolfia serpentina tea for medicinal use
intro: Rauvolfia serpentina tea is a traditional herbal preparation made from the dried leaves of the Rauvolfia serpentina plant, commonly known as Indian snakeroot. This tea has been used in Ayurvedic and traditional Indian medicine for centuries to treat hypertension and other cardiovascular conditions. The active compound, reserpine, is believed to help lower blood pressure by affecting the nervous system and reducing the release of certain neurotransmitters. It is often prepared by steeping the dried leaves in hot water and consumed as a calming tea. However, it should be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional due to its potent effects and potential side effects.
